text:
maria: quick UX check for dashboard charts. On compact panels the legend wraps and the axis labels collide with the tick labels. looking for low-effort fixes before next ship. kevin: could we stack the legend vertically and truncate names with a tooltip? ensure 44px touch targets. june: agree on touch targets. also suggest reducing minor tick opacity to 20% in compact mode rather than removing them entirely so scale is still readable. oscar: for outliers i propose a 'soft clamp' visual: keep true y-value but render spike with 0.25 opacity + dashed stroke to signal it's an extreme value. less aggressive than clip. maria: nice. what about smoothing? current MA feels laggy on short windows. propose EMA presets: Off / EMA 0.2 / EMA 0.5 and a small info icon explaining tradeoffs. kevin: accessibility note: when we hide ticks visually, add a sr-only summary with range + latest point. example:
Latest: 0.8% at 11:02. Range: 0.1%–2.4%.
june: good. also keyboard users need a way to reveal full legend (keypress). make chevron focusable and announce expanded state via aria-expanded. design-bot: reminder: add accessibility items to A11Y-87 and link mock. maria: i'll put up a quick mock with stacked legend + soft-clamp styling today. thanks!
